whole-file dotfile entry or file edit entry

allow_plaintext.description: allow this directly tracked credential-named file to be saved in plaintext history and any connected origin

block.description: block content, maintained between marker comments

comment.description: comment prefix for edit marker lines; inferred from the file extension when omitted

content.description: literal inline file content; alternative to source

dot_prefix.description: symlink-each and directory copy only: deploy each source path component named "dot-<name>" as ".<name>", like GNU Stow's --dotfiles; exclude still matches source names

encrypt.description: encrypt tracked file contents before storing them in Git; the live file remains plaintext

exclude.description: glob patterns to skip when the mode walks a directory (symlink-each, copy with a directory source, or a tracked directory, where they are relative to the tracked path); a pattern without "/" matches any path component, one with "/" is anchored to the root

include.description: history only (mode = "track"): the only paths of the tracked directory that are captured, relative to it and matched like "exclude"; without it the whole tree is captured with the builtin credential filtering, and an explicit "exclude" still wins. A selected file is captured even when it looks like a credential store, in plaintext unless the entry sets encrypt

manifest.description: source manifest used to select managed files from a directory

mode.description: how to apply a whole-file source to the target; omitted uses dotfiles.default_mode. "absent" removes a file or symlink at the target and takes no source

permissions.description: octal permissions for the target, such as "0600"; overrides what copy, template, and inline content entries set, and on its own manages only the permissions of an existing target (Unix only)

position.description: where to insert a missing line

relative.description: symlink and symlink-each only: link by a path relative to the link's directory instead of an absolute one; overrides the dotfiles.relative_symlinks setting (ignored on Windows)

remove_empty.description: template mode only: remove the target when the template renders empty or whitespace-only; a target that changed since mise last wrote it needs --force

template.description: template engine to render block content with; currently only "tera"

variants.description: OS/profile variants: history streams for track mode, or optional destinations for deployment modes

profile.description: mise environment selected with -E or MISE_ENV

target.description: deployment destination override; requires either an explicit source or a safe relative entry key when every variant has a target, and is not supported in track mode

dotfiles.description: dotfiles applied with `mise dotfiles apply` or `mise bootstrap`, keyed by target path or a logical name when every variant overrides the target; an omitted source for the latter resolves the relative key under dotfiles.root
